svg.title: Pregnancy ultrasound: in the first trimester the most advanced landmark visible dates the pregnancy (gestational sac by mean sac diameter, yolk sac which confirms an intrauterine pregnancy but does not date it, then crown-rump length, handing over to fetal biometry after 14 weeks); the 18 to 22 week anatomy scan then checks the number of fetuses, the placental location and the fetal anatomy; each column gives when it is seen, what is read and what follows
